description: Choose where alerts go besides this chat: add_email sends a confirmation link to the address (alerts start only after the user confirms), add_phone returns a private subscribe link for the free ntfy phone app, add_sms (paid plans, U.S. numbers) texts a 6-digit code to phone; pass consent: true only after the user agreed to receive automated alert texts (msg & data rates may apply, reply STOP to cancel), then verify_sms with the code. remove_email, remove_phone and remove_sms stop them, get shows the current setup. One digest is sent after each daily check; at most one text a day. Only add an address or number the user gave for this purpose.
name: manage_alert_delivery
title: Email, phone and text alerts
